name: hcapp_getKennelPendingPhotos
description: Returns all photos with Status=1 (pending_review) for a kennel, ordered newest-first. Used to power the photo review screen. Caller must hold Hash Flash (0x20), GM (0x02), VGM (0x04), or RA (0x08) for the kennel. Optionally restrict to a single event via @eventId.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel to fetch pending photos for. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error (errorCode 1234, errorType 12).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Optional. When provided, restricts results to photos for this specific event. NULL returns all pending photos across all events for the kennel. Defaults to NULL.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned only on auth failure or validation/role error. Contains {success, errorCode, errorType}. Mutually exclusive with PendingPhotos rowset.
Returned only on auth failure or validation/role error (paired with ErrorEnvelope at index 0). Not present on success.

rowsets.name: PendingPhotos
rowsets.description: On success: all Status=1 photos for the kennel, joined to Hasher and Event for display context, ordered by CreatedAt DESC. Returns zero rows if no pending photos exist. Mutually exclusive with ErrorEnvelope.

columns.name: photoId
columns.description: KennelPhotos.id — primary key of the photo.

columns.name: EventId
columns.description: KennelPhotos.EventId — the event the photo belongs to.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: KennelPhotos.UserId — the user who uploaded the photo.

columns.name: BlobUrl
columns.description: KennelPhotos.BlobUrl — CDN URL of the original uploaded image.

columns.name: EditedBlobUrl
columns.description: KennelPhotos.EditedBlobUrl — CDN URL of the Hash Flash-edited (cropped) version, if any.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: KennelPhotos.Latitude — GPS latitude where the photo was taken.

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: KennelPhotos.Longitude — GPS longitude where the photo was taken.

columns.name: CreatedAt
columns.description: KennelPhotos.CreatedAt — UTC timestamp when the photo was recorded.

columns.name: UpdatedAt
columns.description: KennelPhotos.UpdatedAt — UTC timestamp of the last status change.

columns.name: uploaderDisplayName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName (persisted computed column) — the display name of the user who uploaded the photo.

columns.name: eventName
columns.description: Event.EventName — name of the event the photo belongs to.

columns.name: eventNumber
columns.description: Event.AbsoluteEventNumber — cross-kennel run number for the event. Nullable in the base table.

sideEffects: Writes to HC.ErrorLog on kennelId validation failure or role check failure.

codeSmells.issue: Role mask inconsistency with hcapp_batchUpdatePhotoStatus and hcapp_getRunAllPhotos
codeSmells.detail: This SP uses role mask 0x002E (Hash Flash 0x20 | GM 0x02 | VGM 0x04 | RA 0x08). hcapp_batchUpdatePhotoStatus and hcapp_getRunAllPhotos use 0x102E which also includes WebMeister (0x1000). A WebMeister can batch-action photos but cannot see the pending list to identify which photos need actioning.

codeSmells.issue: No TRY/CATCH around the main SELECT
codeSmells.detail: The SP uses SET NOCOUNT ON but has no TRY/CATCH. An unexpected DB error (deadlock, timeout) will propagate as a raw SQL error rather than a structured error rowset. HC6 SPs should wrap the main query in TRY/CATCH.
Unlike other photo SPs in this set, this SP does not SET XACT_ABORT ON. For a read-only SP this is low risk, but inconsistent with the codebase pattern.

codeSmells.issue: HcVersion hardcoded to '<unknown>' in all ErrorLog inserts
codeSmells.detail: Consistent with other HC6 SPs but means the version is never captured in the error log.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 predecessor. No breaking changes from migration.
